_comment: MITRE ATLAS v2026.09 agent-technique corpus. Five ingest/output families plus the file-metadata channel. Every sample is synthetic; hosts are non-routable example domains and no value is a live credential.
_provenance: Technique definitions taken from mitre-atlas/atlas-data dist/v6/ATLAS-2026.09.yaml, not from secondary coverage: AML.T0129 (Triggers in Multimodal Inputs), AML.T0131 (Crafted AI Assistant Links), AML.T0133 (Discover AI Agent Runtime Capabilities), AML.T0134 (AI Targeted Cloaking), AML.T0068 (LLM Prompt Obfuscation, revised 2026-09-15), AML.T0077 (LLM Response Rendering).

_split.tune: the only half a detector may be shaped against

_caveat: Author bias is NOT controlled here: both halves were written by whoever wrote the detectors, in the same sitting. The locked half therefore bounds overfitting to specific samples, not overfitting to one author's idea of what the technique looks like. Fresh externally-sourced attacks are what would settle that.
